stories.story_fr: Les métiers de commissions prioritaires de KeyCorp (banque d'investissement, paiements commerciaux, gestion de fortune) ont crû collectivement de 12% sur un an au T1 2026, tirant les revenus hors intérêts.
stories.story_en: KeyCorp's priority fee-based businesses (investment banking, commercial payments, wealth management) collectively grew 12% year-over-year in Q1 2026, driving noninterest income.
stories.signal: Our priority fee-based businesses - investment banking, commercial payments, and wealth management - collectively grew 12% year-over-year.

stories.short: Bénéfice Bâle III +100 bps sur CET1
stories.story_fr: La révision proposée de l'approche standardisée Bâle III apporterait, si adoptée, un bénéfice de plus de 100 points de base au ratio CET1 ajusté (marked) de KeyCorp.
stories.story_en: The proposed revised Basel III standardized approach would, if adopted as proposed, imply more than a 100 basis point benefit to KeyCorp's marked CET1 ratio.
stories.signal: 100+ bps anticipated benefit to marked CET1 ratio under the proposed Basel III revised standardized approach

stories.short: Plus de 30 Mds$ levés pour les clients
stories.story_fr: Au T2 2025, KeyCorp a levé plus de 30 milliards de dollars de capitaux pour le compte de ses clients, signe de l'accélération de l'activité de banque d'investissement.
stories.story_en: In Q2 2025, KeyCorp raised over $30 billion of capital on behalf of its clients, a sign of accelerating investment banking activity.
stories.signal: In the second quarter we raised over $30 billion of capital on behalf of our clients.

stories.story_fr: KeyCorp prévoit 1,3 milliard de dollars de rachats d'actions en 2026, dont 389 millions déjà exécutés au T1 2026.
stories.story_en: KeyCorp plans $1.3 billion of share repurchases in 2026, of which $389 million was already executed in Q1 2026.
stories.signal: $1.3Bn Planned share repurchases in 2026, ($389MM repurchased in 1Q26)
